notes.title: Russian
notes.content:
Hello friends,
You'll be able to enjoy the game in Russian now, thanks to amazing Svipur, who translated the Goblin and Coins II base game also a year ago, and his mysterious friend (also amazing). There was also a request to make the delay between "I don't need that" sounds a bit longer, so I've set it to 3 seconds instead of 1 for now. I've also added a barely noticeable sound when you pick up a key. 

I hope you're having fun, and if you do - don't forget to let your friends know. 

List of changes/improvements/new features:


 Russian translation by Svipur and friend
 "I don't need that now" sound will wait 3 seconds before playing again
 Added a sound when picking up a key.

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese
notes.content:
Hello friends,
You'll be able to enjoy the game in Brazilian Portuguese now, thanks to amazing Rahone Marcelino, who translated the Goblin and Coins II base game also a year ago. There was also a report of a minor bug that required a very specific situation to occur to manifest, but thanks to a very good error report by Elrinda, it's been dealt with and shouldn't pose any issues in the future. 

I hope you're having fun, and if you do - don't forget to let your friends know. 

List of changes/improvements/new features: 

 Brazilian Portuguese translation by Rahone Marcelino 
 Minor bug fix related to resetting progress under certain conditions

notes.title: The Lost Recipes is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The wait is finally over, The Lost Recipes is OUT NOW and can be purchased on Steam. Please note that, if you already own the previous two games, you can save on top of the -20% launch discount by purchasing the complete the set bundle. 

What awaits you?


     Familiar platforming mechanics, traps and enemies, but improved! 
     25 handcrafted levels
     world 1 very easy, worlds 2 and 3 easy/medium, worlds 4-5 a bit challenging  
     Unlimited continues / level restarts 
     No boss fights, just platforming fun!  
     Double-jump available from the very start of the game 
     5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare (baking), and post your artwork to the game hub 
    English and Serbian language (with Brazilian Portuguese coming soon and more to potentially come later)
   Gamepad support, keyboard re-binding  


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/ 

Please note - if you're using GNU/Linux and your default Proton doesn't work, try switching to version 9.0.2.

notes.title: The Lost Recipes will release on August 28th
notes.content:
Hello little goblins,
Let's head back into adventuring and numismatics! The Lost Recipes, a much easier stand-alone expansion for the Goblin and Coins II, will release on August 28th on Steam.

What can you expect?


         25 handcrafted levels (that get a bit challenging close to the end, but are a walk in the park compared to the most of GnC2 maze-like levels)
         Familiar mechanics, traps and enemies - but improved!
         Unlimited continues / level restarts
         No boss fights, just platforming
         Double-jump available from the very start of the game
         5 brand new recipes to unlock, prepare, and post your artwork to the game hub
         Locked chests, shortcut portals and secret areas 
         Affordable price 
         Doesn't require you to play any previous game 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677680/Goblin_and_Coins_II_The_Lost_Recipes/
